en: Wally
Mr. Norman! I caught a Ralts! Thank you so much for lending me your Zigzagoon.
text: Domnule Norman! Am prins un Ralts! Mulțumesc mult că mi-ați împrumutat Zigzagoonul.

en: And thank you too, {player}. I'll never forget it. I'm going to be a trainer, just like you!
text: Și mulțumesc și ție, {player}. N-o să uit niciodată. O să mă fac Antrenor, la fel ca tine!

en: Norman
That boy's eyes were shining. You did a good thing today, {player}.
text: Băiatului ăluia îi străluceau ochii. Ai făcut un lucru bun azi, {player}.

en: Now, about you. You want to battle me, don't you? I can see it. But I'm a Gym Leader, and I have my rules.
text: Acum, despre tine. Vrei să te lupți cu mine, nu? Se vede. Dar sunt Lider de Arenă și am regulile mele.

en: Win four Gym Badges first. Then come back, and we'll see what you've learned. Start with Rustboro City, north of the woods.
text: Câștigă întâi patru Insigne de Arenă. Apoi întoarce-te și vedem ce-ai învățat. Începe cu Orașul Rustboro, la nord de pădure.

en: Norman
{player}! So you made it to Petalburg on your own. And with a Pokémon of your own, too. I'm proud of you.
text: {player}! Deci ai ajuns până la Petalburg fără nimeni. Și cu Pokémonul tău, pe deasupra. Sunt mândru de tine.

en: It's a long way from Littleroot. Your mother must have told you I'm the Leader of this Gym now.
text: E drum lung de la Littleroot. Mama ta ți-o fi spus că acum eu sunt Liderul acestei Arene.

en: Wally
Um... excuse me. My name is Wally. I'm going to live with my relatives in Verdanturf Town for a while.
text: Ăă... scuzați-mă. Mă numesc Wally. O să locuiesc o vreme la rudele mele din Orășelul Verdanturf.

en: I thought... if I had a Pokémon with me, I wouldn't feel so lonely. But I've never caught one.
text: M-am gândit... că dacă aș avea un Pokémon cu mine, nu m-aș simți atât de singur. Dar n-am prins niciodată unul.

en: Norman
I see. Here, Wally, take my Zigzagoon. Weaken a wild Pokémon with it, then throw a Poké Ball.
text: Înțeleg. Uite, Wally, ia Zigzagoonul meu. Slăbește cu el un Pokémon sălbatic, apoi aruncă un Poké Ball.

en: {player}, go with Wally and keep an eye on him. There's tall grass just east of town.
text: {player}, mergi cu Wally și ai grijă de el. E iarbă înaltă chiar la est de oraș.

en: Wally
Th-thank you, Mr. Norman! Let's go, {player}!
text: M-mulțumesc, domnule Norman! Hai să mergem, {player}!

en: Norman
Four Gym Badges, {player}. Then come back and face me. Start with Roxanne in Rustboro City.
You've won Rustboro's Badge? Well done! Brawly's Gym is next, in Dewford Town across the sea. Mr. Briney sails there.
You've grown stronger, {player}. I can see it in the way your Pokémon look at you. Keep going: four Badges.
Norman
So. You really have won four Gym Badges. Then, as I promised, we'll battle.
{player}... I can't tell you how glad I am to face my own child in a real battle.
But a battle is a battle. As a Gym Leader, I'll give it everything I have!
I... lost? To you, {player}? I can hardly believe it.
But rules are rules. You've earned this. Take it.
{player} received the Balance Badge from Norman!
With the Balance Badge, your Pokémon can use Surf outside of battle to cross the water.
And take this as well.
TM42 holds Facade. When its user is poisoned, burned or paralysed, it hits twice as hard. Turn a bad spot into strength!
As a Gym Leader, I'm more upset than I can say. But as your father... it makes me happy, and a little sad. Strange, isn't it?
Wally's Father
Ah, there you are, {player}! Would you come with me? There's something I'd like you to have.
Norman, you won't mind if I borrow {player} for a minute or two, will you?
Norman
TM42 holds Facade. When its user is poisoned, burned or paralysed, it hits twice as hard. Turn a bad spot into strength!
Go and see your mother now and then, {player}. I'll be here, training harder than ever. I can't stay beaten by my own child!

Hey there! This is the Petalburg Gym. Norman's rooms each test a trainer's skill a different way.
But the doors stay shut until you've got four Badges. Rules are rules!
Four Badges! The doors are open to you now. Each one beyond opens once you beat the trainer in its room.
The left door goes to the Speed Room, the right to the Accuracy Room. Norman's Pokémon are Normal types: Fighting moves hit them hard!
You beat your own father! Whoa. I don't think anybody in Petalburg will ever forget that battle.
